quickAnswer: Custom holographic stickers are printed on a silver film embossed with a micro pattern that splits light into a rainbow. We print white ink where colors should stay solid and leave the film bare where it should shimmer. They suit product labels, packaging seals, merch and event passes. sections.h2: How holographic film works, and what the die cut holographic page is for
sections.html:
Holographic film is a silver base with a pattern embossed into it at a scale finer than a hair. Tilt it and the pattern bends light into bands of color, so the sticker looks different from every angle and under every lamp. Nothing is printed to make that happen; it is the film itself. What we print on top is your artwork in CMYK, with a white ink layer underneath wherever you want a color to read as a flat, true color instead of a shimmering one.

This is the material page: holographic film in squares, circles, rolls, kiss cut sheets and contour cuts, for labels as much as for stickers. If the shape is the point, say a mascot cut tightly to its outline so the rainbow edge traces the drawing, the holographic die cut sticker page goes deeper on borders and cut lines for that kind of job. Come here to work out whether holographic is the right base at all, and how to set the art up for it.

sections.h2: Deciding which parts of the design shine and which stay solid
sections.html:
The single biggest decision on a holographic order is where the white ink goes. The film shows through anything printed without white behind it, which is the effect most buyers want, but it also makes a logo hard to read if the whole thing is left open. The usual answer is a mix.

Logo and body textYes, fullSolid, accurate brand colorAnything that has to be read at a glance
Background shapesNoneFull rainbow shiftBorders, badges, starbursts
Tinted areasNone, color at 20 to 50 percentColored shimmerGradients, glows, metallic-looking fills
Thin outlinesPartialCrisp line with a slight sparkleLine art, lettering outlines

We build the white layer from your file and show it on the proof as its own view. A good rule for first-time buyers: back everything you would print on a white label, leave the decorative parts open, and check the proof on screen with the brightness up.

sections.h2: Holographic labels on packaging, seals and limited editions
sections.html:
Holographic label printing is where this film does its best work, because packaging sits under store lighting and moves in the hand. A 2-inch round seal over a box flap, a 3 x 4 inch front label on a candle tin, a 1 x 3 inch tamper strip across a lid. Small sizes show the effect just as well as large ones and cost far less, so most label orders sit between 1 and 4 inches.

  • Cosmetics and skincare labels, where the shimmer reads as premium without a foil-stamping setup charge.
  • Tamper-evident seals and limited-edition badges on boxes, bags and bottles.
  • Laptop and water bottle stickers sold as merch, kiss cut on sheets for easy handling.
  • Event wristband tags and lanyard stickers that are hard to photocopy convincingly.
  • Vinyl record and cassette sleeves, where the film echoes the artwork palette.

One honest note on the phrase hologram stickers. These are printed holographic-film stickers, not serialized security holograms with a hidden image. They deter casual copying because the film is distinctive, but they are not an authentication system.

sections.h2: Preparing artwork so the rainbow helps instead of fighting the design
sections.html:
Holographic film is busy. Designs that look great on white vinyl can turn into noise on a rainbow base. These are the steps our design team walks through with every new holographic file, and we do them for free if you would rather send a plain logo and let us set it up.

  1. Simplify. Remove fine textures and drop shadows; the film supplies the texture already.
  2. Pick two or three flat colors, including at least one dark one for the text.
  3. Mark which elements get white backing and which stay open. If you are unsure, back the text and leave the rest.
  4. Thicken strokes. Lines thinner than 1 point get lost in the shimmer.
  5. Send the file as vector PDF, AI, EPS or SVG at the finished size, or a 300 dpi PNG with a transparent background.

We return a proof with a simulated holographic view. It is a simulation, so if you want to see the real thing before committing a large run, a 100-piece first order is the cheapest way to check it in your own packaging under your own lights.

sections.h2: Durability, lamination and where holographic does not belong
sections.html:
The film is a vinyl or PET base with the same acrylic adhesive as our other stickers, so it sticks to glass, plastic, painted metal and coated card the same way. Laminated, it holds up to 3 years outdoors; indoors it lasts far longer than that. The laminate also matters for packaging that gets handled, because fingerprints show more on a mirror-like surface than on matte paper.

Where to hesitate: full-sun outdoor signage for years at a time, where plain white vinyl lasts longer; and tiny text-only labels, where the effect goes unnoticed and a cheaper stock would do. If what you really want is a label that shows the product behind it rather than a shimmer, our custom clear sticker range uses the same white-ink approach on a transparent base. Matte lamination over holographic film is worth asking about: it tones the shimmer down to a soft pearl, which suits skincare and candle brands.

sections.h2: Quantities, pricing and how a holographic order runs
sections.html:
Holographic film costs more per square foot than white vinyl, so size drives price more here than on any other sticker we make. A 2-inch holographic circle at 500 pieces costs little more than the same circle in white vinyl; a 6-inch one costs noticeably more. Keep the shape compact and you keep the price close to $0.30 per piece at volume.

Minimum is 100 per design. Proof comes within a business day, production is 5 to 7 business days after you approve it, and FedEx delivery inside the United States is free. Rolls, sheets and individually cut pieces all run on the same film, and you can mix holographic with white or clear stickers on one order so a packaging set arrives together, with every option listed on the Die Cut Stickers home page.

faqs.q: Do custom holographic stickers show my brand colors accurately?
faqs.a: Yes where we print white ink underneath. The white layer gives the CMYK or Pantone inks a solid base, so a red logo stays red. Areas without white take on the rainbow of the film, which is the effect, not a flaw. The proof shows both so you can adjust.

faqs.q: Are holographic stickers waterproof enough for bottles and tumblers?
faqs.a: Yes. The film does not absorb water, and with a laminate the print is sealed against washing and condensation. They handle hand washing and the top rack of a home dishwasher. For commercial dishwashers, ask for the PET base rather than vinyl.

faqs.q: How long do holographic stickers last outdoors?
faqs.a: Laminated, up to 3 years outdoors, a little less than plain white vinyl because the mirror layer is more affected by UV. Indoors, on packaging, laptops and walls, they last well beyond that. Unlaminated holographic prints are best kept indoors.

faqs.q: Can I order custom holographic labels on a roll?
faqs.a: Yes. Rolls are the usual format for anyone labeling with a dispenser or a semi-automatic applicator. Tell us your core size and the unwind direction. Rolls start at the same 100-piece minimum, and the unit price drops quickly from 500 pieces up.

faqs.q: What does hologram sticker printing cost compared with regular vinyl?
faqs.a: The film costs more, so the gap depends on size. A 2-inch holographic sticker costs only slightly more than its white vinyl equivalent at the same quantity. At 5 or 6 inches the difference is larger. Pricing still starts at $0.30 per sticker at volume.

faqs.q: Can holographic stickers be matte instead of shiny?
faqs.a: Yes. A matte laminate over the holographic film cuts the glare and turns the rainbow into a soft pearl shift. Skincare, candle and stationery brands often prefer it. The color shift is still visible, just quieter, and fingerprints show far less.

faqs.q: Will small text be readable on a holographic sticker?
faqs.a: Readable if it is backed with white ink and set at 6 point or larger in a dark color. Unbacked text disappears into the shimmer at small sizes. For ingredient panels or legal text, we recommend a white-backed block and keeping the open film for decorative areas.

faqs.q: Do you offer holographic die cut shapes or only circles and squares?
faqs.a: Any shape. Circles, squares and rounded rectangles are the cheapest to cut. Custom contours around a logo or character cost a little more on complex outlines and are covered in detail on the holographic die cut page. Kiss cut sheets and rolls are also available.

faqs.q: Can holographic stickers be removed from a laptop without residue?
faqs.a: With removable adhesive, yes, cleanly for around a year. Permanent adhesive will still come off a laptop lid with gentle heat and a slow peel, followed by a wipe with isopropyl alcohol. Choose removable at the quote stage if you expect to swap stickers.

faqs.q: Is a holographic sticker a security hologram?
faqs.a: No. A security hologram is a serialized, custom-mastered image used for authentication. Our holographic stickers are printed on a standard diffraction film with your art on top. They look distinctive and are hard to copy casually, but they are a branding product, not an anti-counterfeit system.

faqs.q: What file should I send for holographic label printing?
faqs.a: A vector file (PDF, AI, EPS or SVG) at the finished size, with the areas that should be white-backed either marked on a separate layer or described in a note. A 300 dpi PNG with a transparent background works too. We set up the white layer and send a proof.

faqs.q: How many holographic stickers can I order per design?
faqs.a: From 100 up to tens of thousands. Short runs print digitally; long runs move to offset for a lower unit price. Each design needs its own 100-piece minimum, and different designs can share one shipment. Production is 5 to 7 business days regardless of count unless you ask for rush.
